asset.name: NavigationGenerator
asset.description: Produces navigation trees, rails, sidebars, breadcrumbs, commands, and compact-viewport navigation from one route-and-permission model.

requires.reason: Output configures the composed navigation asset so every presentation stays derived from one model.

rationale: One model producing every presentation is what keeps the sidebar, the bottom bar, and the breadcrumb trail from disagreeing about the application's own structure.
